results.content: Evaluating 44 reviews, most reviewers were unhappy with their experience overall. Customers frequently encounter frustrating chat filters that constantly block completely normal conversations and character creation without providing any clear reasons or helpful explanations. Consumers also experience annoying technical glitches, excessive advertisements that completely disrupt interactions, and un expected account restrictions while trying to enjoy the service.
